v.text:
The first one is how far you want the hitbox to spawn from the player's Y position. For example, I'd use 75 to spawn the hitbox in the air appose to spawning it under the floor with -75. 

The second one is for the X position. Except instead of offsetting it changes depending on where the player is looking. For example, I'd do 55 to spawn the hitbox in front of me, and -55 spawning it behind me, no matter which way I'm looking.

nv.text:

First of all, you need to know how to use certain hitboxes. Since the Halloween update, there's been a new hitbox called the 'tumble hitbox' I'll also be covering how to use that one too.

And if you're not too good at coding, you can always just retexture the moves and tweak the hitbox settings which are in the code. It's just changing variables, that's all.
